# Q5 -- coincident faces (generated by `occt_probe q5`)

OCCT 8.0.1, osx-arm64. Lengths in micrometres. Counts are solids/shells/faces/edges/vertices. `rel err` is the result volume against the analytic value. A **sliver** is a face below 1e-6 of the smallest input face's area.
